policy: Hardware mechanisms belong in kernel/DT; original distribution consumers retain userspace functions. Preserve every feature and qualify DNF, settings and rollback before retirement. No new runtime bridge RPM.

components.remaining_work: Keep the single cumulative unstable queue, existing config/DT/features and accepted recovery. Stable promotion requires explicit user instruction.

Use native power_supply control, events and error semantics. Stock 1.91.5 still differs on unknown health and late capacity; Core22 permits the standard provider but is not installed. Qualify threshold errors, wireless, settings/history, DNF and physical charging before removing the fork.

Move hardware protection/lifecycle to kernel events. Keep diagnostic and offline-charge UI in userspace, with necessary integration in existing Control. The observer/offline outputs still require this producer; the charge-helper fold alone does not retire it.

Complete native IIO streams, validity, units, matrices, quaternion/heading, multi-reader lifetime, power, DSP restart and legacy rollback. Magnetic accuracy/heading parity remains open; game rotation is not a compass.

Stock accel/combined ALS/input proximity have bounded device evidence. Complete both-light selection, compass, cold boot/suspend, D-Bus acquisition and SELinux parity before selecting the original provider.

Separate remoteproc/transport ownership from necessary registry file service. Keep calibration private and read-only; fold unavoidable userspace work into existing Control only after lifecycle, file ownership and rollback parity.

Kernel owns DRM/MSM resources, not compilers or graphics APIs. Resolve AArch64 JIT, Adreno732 identity, display-fd and UBWC differences upstream; qualify original Fedora GL/Vulkan/compute, DMA-BUF and suspend without CPU-render fallback.

Original signed 22.1.8-4 can enumerate the GPU in an isolated namespace but compiler/bitcode compatibility and shader/compute correctness remain unqualified. Do not move compiler data into the kernel.

Complete native Iris/V4L2 capability and error handling plus an upstream userspace backend compatible with the stateful codec. V4L2 registration alone is not VA-API playback. Preserve formats, seeking, rate, errors and session behavior before retirement.

Control already owns the folded startup client; native ASoC owns topology/protection. Preserve Ready2, four speakers/mics, DP and surround. Qualify physical channel geometry, rotation, gain243 protection, dependency/recovery closure before removing the retained producer.

Retain package/update/rollback, session preferences and necessary event/demand integration. Migrate hardware protocols to kernel/DT; healthy idle waits on notifications. Qualified 217r2 is not installed and its two-second protection observation is not fully event driven.
Retain project UI and standard desktop APIs; move no application/package transaction policy into the kernel. Preserve main/TUI/GUI compatibility and settings while retiring redundant helpers.
Retain project UI using original GTK/GNOME libraries and the existing Control protocol; no GNOME package fork or duplicate hardware protocol service.

Move accessory transport, authentication lifetime and input/HID ownership to native drivers using exact Uke evidence; retain necessary trusted firmware and privacy boundaries. Qualify attach/detach, keys, pointer, suspend and recovery.
Retain session/layout policy through standard desktop interfaces; fold necessary Uke integration into existing Control after native accessory and settings parity.

Retain licensed required blobs until the distribution supplies exact compatible files and kernel paths. Firmware loading belongs to kernel drivers; private calibration is not a public firmware payload.
Preserve required amplifier/DSP firmware, topology and calibration boundaries. Distribution/upstream data adoption and audio protection parity precede consolidation/removal.
Retain exact compatible CDSP/accessory firmware until native remoteproc/HID and licensed distribution file/path equivalence are proven.

Fedora 1.25-28 lacks upstream destructor fix 270a66d5. Obtain the correction in the original distribution package, then qualify ABI, accounts, ownership and rollback; this memory-management fix cannot move into kernel/DT.
Qualify original optional-TCB ENOENT semantics while preserving genuine permission/I/O errors and normal accounts; seek upstream/Fedora correction rather than kernel workarounds.

Installed same-name COPR rebuild carries first-line read/memory-safety corrections. Verify equivalent original source and DDC error/hotplug fixtures before replacement; no producer presence is required to detect the installed fork.

Original signed 6.12.0-1 lacks MultiSoundEffect.qml/QtMultimedia registrations present in the installed rebuild. Preserve key sound via an original Fedora correction or standard Control-owned style before switching.
Audit the exact remaining base-policy delta and qualify original Fedora policy with narrowly scoped existing integration modules; retain confinement and supported upgrades.

Audit the rebuilt source and select an unmodified supported upstream/distribution provider if available. VPN/session logic stays in userspace; do not fabricate a Fedora replacement or remove remote-access functionality.

Resolve Linux portability/context ABI upstream and qualify an available original provider. The SDK is userspace; an installed package does not prove frame generation. Retain required build/source dependencies until closed.
Audit exact feature/dependency differences and validate an original distribution package with document/UI parity and rollback; no CAD functionality belongs in the kernel.
Preserve necessary theme/metadata resources and original desktop packages; remove redundant packaging only after file ownership, appearance/settings and DNF closure.
Inspect required resource licenses and active source/runtime users; consolidate necessary public data only, preserving private calibration and recovery references.

Use standard virtual providers after parity. Preserve the accepted Core21 payload/other dependencies and qualify prepared Core22 UPower dependency transition without removing Core or reverting original audio.
Retain original KDE/GNOME package selections, supported DNF transitions and user choices. Meta packages are not hardware drivers.
Kernel owns binder, DMA and native GPU/media mechanisms. Keep container/session policy in original Waydroid and only necessary existing Control integration; qualify Android and native desktop parity.
Retain necessary image/manifest tooling; complete fastboot-update/DTBO/Live Recovery and encryption qualification without GPT changes or unrelated firmware writes.
Preserve the accepted independent recovery route until a physically qualified replacement and source/artifact closure exist.
Keep essential native source/ARM64 qualification and required receipts. Retire temporary diagnostics only after all live build, source, runtime and recovery references close.

retired_source_families.replacement: Original Fedora PipeWire; preserve qualified Core21 migration and stock WirePlumber.
Original Fedora accessibility packages; see consolidation/gnu-return-results.md.
